Bill.BriefDescription: Adding additional requirements for the storage of ammonia.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to unlawful storage of ammonia; amending RCW69.55.020; and prescribing penalties.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 69.55.020 and 2002 c 133 s 2 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A person is guilty of the crime of unlawful storage of ammoniaif the person possesses, transports, or delivers pressurized ammoniagas or pressurized ammonia gas solution in a container that (((1))):(a) Is not approved by the United States department of transportationto hold ammonia((, or (2))); (b) was not constructed to meet state andfederal industrial health and safety standards for holding ammonia; (c)is not conspicuously and legibly marked with the proper United Nationsidentification number; (d) has fittings that contain brass, copper, orgalvanized steel; (e) allows ammonia gas to escape from the containerwhen any valve or other fitting is in the closed, shut, or offposition; or (f) does not contain a lock on the valve or other fittingas to help prevent the theft of the pressurized ammonia gas or gassolution. (2) Violation of this section is a class C felony. p. 1 HB 2263 (3) This section does not apply to public employees or privatecontractors authorized to clean up and dispose of hazardous waste ortoxic substances under chapter 70.105 or 70.105D RCW or to solid wastehaulers and their employees who unknowingly possess, transport, ordeliver pressurized ammonia gas or pressurized ammonia gas solutionduring the course of the performance of their duties.
